item.title: libredwg: 0.13.4 -> 0.13.4.8200
item.description:
Summary

Update libredwg to latest pre-release 0.13.4.8200 to fix 8 security vulnerabilities:

  • CVE-2026-9500: heap-buffer-overflow in decode.c (decompress_R2004_section) — upstream, fixes #524384
  • CVE-2026-9501: heap-buffer-overflow in decode.c (read_2004_compressed_section) — upstream, fixes #524385
  • CVE-2026-9502: heap-buffer-overflow in decode.c (decompress_R2004_section) — upstream, fixes #524380
  • CVE-2026-9503: heap-buffer-overflow in decode.c (decompress_R2004_section) — upstream, fixes #524381
  • CVE-2026-9504: null pointer dereference in dwggrep.c (main) — upstream, fixes #524382
  • CVE-2026-9529: heap-buffer-overflow in decode.c (decompress_R2004_section) — upstream, fixes #524788
  • CVE-2026-9530: heap-buffer-overflow in decode.c (read_2004_compressed_section) — upstream, fixes #524773
  • CVE-2026-9605: heap-buffer-overflow in bits.c (bit_read_RC) — upstream, fixes #524780

All CVEs were fixed upstream on the main branch through a significant refactoring of the R2004 decompressor. Individual backports to 0.13.4 were not feasible due to the extent of the changes, so this updates to the latest pre-release which includes all fixes.

Verification

  • Package builds successfully
  • PoC files from CVE reports that previously triggered SIGABRT/SIGSEGV now exit cleanly

Test plan

  • [x] nix-build succeeds for libredwg
  • [x] PoC files for CVE-2026-9501, CVE-2026-9502, CVE-2026-9504 verified fixed
  • [ ] FreeCAD build (reverse dependency via libredwg) — to be verified

cc @NixOS/security
